featured_reviews.name: Anoop balakrishnan
featured_reviews.review_text:
I got this tattoo done yesterday at Inkhub by Mr. Aman Bhadreshwara, and honestly, I’m still amazed by how it turned out.

I walked in around 9:30 AM with just a rough idea of what I wanted in my mind. I didn’t have a final design, only a concept. Aman took that concept and completely elevated it. He shared multiple design options, patiently explained things, and really listened to every small detail I mentioned.

The session was long — we finished around 9:00 PM — but his focus and energy never dropped. I was on a strict one-day timeline, and he made sure the entire piece was completed perfectly within that day, without compromising on quality even a bit.

What impressed me the most is how well he understood what I was actually looking for, even when I couldn’t explain it clearly myself. The final tattoo came out way better than I ever imagined. For me, this tattoo was a dream, and seeing it come to life like this is something I’ll always be grateful for.

Aman is not just highly skilled, but also very polite, calm, and professional. You can tell he genuinely cares about his work and the people he tattoos.

If you’re thinking of getting a tattoo and want someone who will truly turn your idea into reality, I highly recommend Inkhub and Mr. Aman Bhadreshwara. Worth every minute and every bit of trust.
